title: Multicenter development of an interpretable machine learning model for prognosis of acute pancreatitis with acute kidney injury.
summary: A Random Forest model selected from 24 machine-learning models predicted 60-day mortality for acute-pancreatitis patients with acute kidney injury using 18 screened clinical features from MIMIC-IV, with SHAP interpretation and an online application.
ai_technology: A Random Forest model selected from 24 machine-learning models predicted 60-day mortality for acute-pancreatitis patients with acute kidney injury using 18 screened clinical features from MIMIC-IV, with SHAP interpretation and an online application.
organization: The First Affiliated Hospital of Anhui University of Chinese Medicine

evidence.tested: The RF model reached AUC 0.8963 in internal validation and 0.8122 in independent eICU validation despite class imbalance and center heterogeneity; prospective randomized utility remains untested.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.
